title: When the delta is fake: Three public agent-eval tasks with nop starters, frozen controls, and a scored fail trace
description: Technical report and public mini-suite for agent evaluation craft. Three tasks (clearing-hold-ledger, slot-ring-buffer, site-shift-meter) with nop starters, oracles, artifact-recomputed scores, calibration notes, a staged fail trace rubric, and companion links to Harbor PR #4003 and Terminal-Bench PR #2480 (lease-fencing-reaper).
